row: Welcome to New Smyrna Spine and Injury Center channel! Your New Smyrna Beach Chiropractor, Dr. Don Walsh, has been practicing for almost 10 years. Through this channel we want to help people learn more about the amazing potential of chiropractic care to safely, effectively and naturally treat various debilitating musculoskeletal conditions or just for overall health maintenance. This enables natural healthy living, without resorting to habit-forming drugs or invasive surgery. Dr. Walsh uses holistic system of assessing and adjusting the spine with precision. For any questions about this practice, please visit www.NewSmyrnaSpine.com or call (386) 423-2415. This channel will enable you to see all the different types of cases that Dr. Walsh treats- from professional athletes, to weekend warriors, the veterans, the infants to the elderly. Chiropractic treatment is for all ages. To stay updated, please subscribe to this channel.
